Rexy 360 puts a virtual remote head inside your 360 footage. You operate '''pan''', '''tilt''', '''roll''' and '''zoom''' as you would on a real head.

== Wheel modes ==
; Absolute : The wheel position is the angle.
; Continuous : The wheel drives a speed, like a fluid head.

== Head options ==
* '''Horizon''' or '''Frame''' roll.
* '''Swoop'''.
* '''Unlimited tilt'''.
* '''Soft stops'''.
* '''Autolevel'''.
* Per-axis tuning with '''S / C / D / F''' (sensitivity, curve, damping, filter) — see [[Rexy 360: Controllers and inputs#Tuning an axis|Tuning an axis]].

Zoom is controlled from the '''Lens''' section — see [[Rexy 360: Lenses|Lenses]].
